data.narrative:
Delian Alliance Industries is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $14M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 10 comparable companies: two public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, all operating in the same sector and stage cohort.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $14M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $35M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A)—yields a median of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The wide spread reflects material stage and maturity differences within the peer set.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $30M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $218M. The extreme dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects tension between Delian's early capital deployment and the valuations achieved by later-stage defense-tech peers. Key uncertainties include market traction, technical differentiation relative to named competitors, and whether peer valuations reflect sustainable unit economics or earlier-stage pricing euphoria in the sector.
